# evroc_subnet (Data Source)

Get information about an existing evroc subnet.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Name of the subnet to look up.

### Optional

- `project` (String) Project this resource belongs to.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) Creation timestamp (RFC3339).
- `fqid` (String) Fully qualified resource ID.
- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `ipv4_cidr_block` (String) IPv4 CIDR block.
- `region` (String) Region of the subnet.
- `stack_type` (String) Stack type (dual-stack or ipv6-only).
- `subnet_id` (String) Unique identifier (UUID).
- `system_labels` (Map of String) System-managed labels.
- `user_labels` (Map of String) User-defined labels.
- `vpc_ref` (String) Reference to the parent VPC.
- `zone` (String) Zone of the subnet.
